name: ID
reader: apps/id/src/config.ts, read from the root .env by bun dev

fields.name: NODE_ENV
fields.doc: development, test or production (unset, development): the first two fill unset variables with local defaults, production none; the images set production

fields.name: PORT
fields.doc: The port ID listens on

fields.name: DATABASE_URL
fields.doc: ID's Postgres URL as its restricted runtime login, never the schema owner

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
fields.doc: ID's origin: the issuer, the pages' origin and the base of the admin API's audience

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
fields.doc: The application secret, at least 32 characters: signs cookies and encrypts what ID stores

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS
fields.doc: The rotation ring, version:secret pairs separated by commas: the first writes, every one decrypts

fields.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
fields.doc: The Google platform application's client ID; set it with GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET or leave both unset

fields.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.doc: The Google platform application's client secret

fields.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
fields.doc: The Entra platform application's client ID; set it with MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET or leave both unset

fields.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.doc: The Entra platform application's client secret

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
fields.doc: Origins trusted besides ID's own, separated by commas: browser origins and identity-provider endpoints; production requires them

fields.name: ROOT_ADMIN_SECRET
fields.doc: The root bearer, at least 32 characters, for the first run; it stops working once a person holds platform:write

fields.name: ROOT_ADMIN_BREAK_GLASS
fields.doc: true keeps the root bearer working after a person holds platform:write; for break-glass only

fields.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
fields.doc: The ingress proxies' networks, IPv4 or IPv6, separated by commas; production requires them

fields.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX
fields.doc: Connections per process; size it with docs/06's formula against the database's limit

fields.name: NODE_ENV
fields.doc: development, test or production (unset, development): the first two fill unset variables with local defaults, production none; the images set production

fields.name: DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL
fields.doc: ID's Postgres URL as the schema owner, for the migration only

fields.name: DATABASE_RUNTIME_ROLE
fields.doc: The restricted role the migration provisions and ID serves as

fields.name: NODE_ENV
fields.doc: development, test or production (unset, development): the first two fill unset variables with local defaults, production none; the images set production

fields.name: TEST_DATABASE_URL
fields.doc: The disposable database ID's test suite resets, named answerable_id_test

name: MCP
reader: packages/mcp/src/environment.ts, read by readMcpEnvironment for the e2e server (bun run mcp:dev) and a scaffolded one

fields.name: NODE_ENV
fields.doc: development, test or production (unset, development): the first two fill unset variables with local defaults, production none; the images set production

fields.name: MCP_ID_ISSUER
fields.doc: The Answerable ID issuer whose tokens the server accepts

fields.name: MCP_RESOURCE_URL
fields.doc: The server's own URL, the audience of the tokens it accepts

fields.name: MCP_PORT
fields.doc: The port the server listens on; each MCP running at the same time needs its own

name: ops
reader: infra/ops/src/commands.ts, set by charts/answerable for the bootstrap, register and make-admin Jobs (infra/ops/README.md)

fields.name: NODE_ENV
fields.doc: development, test or production (unset, development): the first two fill unset variables with local defaults, production none; the images set production

fields.name: OPS_NAMESPACE
fields.doc: bootstrap and register: the namespace of the Secrets they write, read by src/kubernetes.ts; unset, the service account's

fields.name: OPS_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL
fields.doc: bootstrap: the managed database's administrative login (CREATEDB and CREATEROLE), a URL with sslmode=verify-full

fields.name: OPS_DATABASE_SSLROOTCERT
fields.doc: bootstrap: where the chart mounts the database's certificate authority, for the services' URLs

fields.name: OPS_ID_URL
fields.doc: register and make-admin: ID's origin

fields.name: OPS_ID_TOKEN
fields.doc: register: a staff token, used over OPS_ID_ROOT_SECRET once ID's root secret is locked

fields.name: OPS_ID_ROOT_SECRET
fields.doc: register and make-admin: ID's root secret, ROOT_ADMIN_SECRET

fields.name: OPS_TOOLBOX_URL
fields.doc: register: the Toolbox's origin

fields.name: OPS_ADMIN_MCP_URL
fields.doc: register: the admin MCP's origin

fields.name: OPS_PLATFORM_SLUG
fields.doc: register and make-admin: the platform organisation's slug

fields.name: OPS_CLAUDE_CALLBACK_PORT
fields.doc: register: the port of Claude Code's OAuth callback that the clients allow

fields.name: OPS_START_DEPLOYMENTS
fields.doc: register: the Deployments to start once their client secrets exist, name=replicas separated by commas

fields.name: OPS_STAFF_DOMAIN
fields.doc: register: the staff email domain to connect to the platform organisation, with OPS_ENTRA_TENANT

fields.name: OPS_ENTRA_TENANT
fields.doc: register: the staff directory's Entra tenant ID, a GUID, with OPS_STAFF_DOMAIN

fields.name: OPS_ADMIN_EMAIL
fields.doc: make-admin: the email of the staff member, signed in once, to make the first administrator

fields.name: MCP_POSTGRES_TEST_DATABASE_URL
fields.doc: The disposable database @answerable/mcp-postgres's tests reset, named answerable_mcp_postgres_test

name: web
reader: apps/web, read from apps/web/.env.local by Next.js (apps/web/.env.example)

fields.name: GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID
fields.doc: The waitlist's spreadsheet ID; locally, without it and the two below, a sign-up is logged instead; production needs all three

fields.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
fields.doc: The service account that writes the waitlist's sheet

fields.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY
fields.doc: The service account's private key, on one line with \n kept

fields.name: OAUTH_TEST_ISSUER
fields.doc: The /oauth-test consumer's Answerable ID, in development only

fields.name: OAUTH_TEST_CLIENT_ID
fields.doc: The /oauth-test consumer's client in ID

fields.name: OAUTH_TEST_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.doc: The /oauth-test consumer's client secret

fields.name: OAUTH_TEST_REDIRECT_URI
fields.doc: The /oauth-test consumer's callback, http://localhost:47100/api/oauth-test/callback

name: GitHub environment
reader: read by the workflows, never from a .env file (infra/README.md)

fields.name: CIVO_TOKEN
fields.doc: The environment's Civo account API key; the owner pastes it

fields.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
fields.doc: A Cloudflare token scoped to the environment's zone only; the owner pastes it

fields.name: GH_SECRETS_TOKEN
fields.doc: A token that writes this environment's secrets, for the bootstrap workflow and Terraform; the owner pastes it

fields.name: STATE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
fields.doc: The Terraform state's object store key ID; the bootstrap workflow writes it

fields.name: STATE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
fields.doc: The Terraform state's object store secret; the bootstrap workflow writes it

fields.name: KUBE_SERVER
fields.doc: The cluster's API server, for the deploy step; Terraform writes it

fields.name: KUBE_CA
fields.doc: The cluster's certificate authority, for the deploy step; Terraform writes it

fields.name: KUBE_TOKEN
fields.doc: The deployer's token, for the deploy step; Terraform writes it

name: infra tooling
reader: read by bun run infra:test and bun run infra:check

fields.name: INFRA_STACK_KEEP
fields.doc: 1 keeps the kind stack's cluster after bun run infra:test

fields.name: TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR
fields.doc: Moves infra:check's Terraform provider cache
